title: Grateful Dead Live at Sports Palace on 1981-10-19
source: 2 source matrix by Dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:095781) Recording Info: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD -> EAC -> SHN; Transfer Info: SHN -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC; and Audience (shnid:131465) Beyer M-160>Sony TC-D5m; Transfer 1st set MAC>Sony TC-K3es>USBPre2; Transfer 2nd set 1st Gen>Sony TC-K3es>USBPre2; Recorded center directly in back of soundboard; Recorded and transferred By Richie stankiewicz

ai_review.summary: Matrix recording delivers a clear, energetic Barcelona performance highlighted by a superb Jack Straw → Franklin's segue and a bouncy Don't Ease Me In.
ai_review.review: The audience‑sourced matrix capture is praised for its pleasant clarity and the way it conveys the crowd’s excitement in Spain. Musically the show shines with an engaging first set, a hot second set that flows into a lively Don't Ease Me In, and a standout Jack Straw → Franklin's transition. Reviewers rank it among their top Dead shows, noting both great sound and memorable energy.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers give high marks (4‑5 stars) and comment positively on both performance and sound; limited number of reviews lowers confidence to medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the matrix as very enjoyable with clear, great‑sound quality that captures crowd energy; no major flaws noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid first set followed by a hot second set that flows naturally into a bouncy Don't Ease Me In, creating an overall wonderful night in Spain.
